---
title: "Descriptives text"
format: pdf
---

```{r}
#| label: get-models
#| echo: false
# Init cache
cache <- storr::storr_rds("Cache")

# Get data
postdata <- cache$get("postdata")
d_srh <- postdata$d_srh
d_swl <- postdata$d_swl

# Get models
SrhTud0 <- cache$get("SrhTud0")
SrhTud3 <- cache$get("SrhTud3")
SwlTud0 <- cache$get("SwlTud0")
SwlTud3 <- cache$get("SwlTud3")
SrhCbc0 <- cache$get("SrhCbc0")
SrhCbc3 <- cache$get("SrhCbc3")
SwlCbc0 <- cache$get("SwlCbc0")
SwlCbc3 <- cache$get("SwlCbc3")
```

```{r}
#| label: get-result-text-numbers
#| echo: false

# Individuals
all_srh <- d_srh |>
  nrow() |>
  format(big.mark = ",")

all_swl <- d_swl |>
  nrow() |>
  format(big.mark = ",")

# Missings
all_missing_srh_low <- min(
  d_srh |>
    nrow() |>
    magrittr::subtract(SrhTud0$nobs),
  d_srh |>
    nrow() |>
    magrittr::subtract(SrhCbc0$nobs)
) |>
  format(big.mark = ",")

all_missing_srh_high <- max(
  d_srh |>
    nrow() |>
    magrittr::subtract(SrhTud3$nobs),
  d_srh |>
    nrow() |>
    magrittr::subtract(SrhCbc3$nobs)
) |>
  format(big.mark = ",")

all_missing_swl_low <- min(
  d_swl |>
    nrow() |>
    magrittr::subtract(SwlTud0$nobs),
  d_swl |>
    nrow() |>
    magrittr::subtract(SwlCbc0$nobs)
) |>
  format(big.mark = ",")

all_missing_swl_high <- max(
  d_swl |>
    nrow() |>
    magrittr::subtract(SwlTud3$nobs),
  d_swl |>
    nrow() |>
    magrittr::subtract(SwlCbc3$nobs)
) |>
  format(big.mark = ",")

# Countries
n_countries_srh <- d_srh$c |>
  unique() |>
  length()

n_countries_swl <- d_swl$c |>
  unique() |>
  length()

c_in_swl_notin_srh <- d_swl$country[d_swl$country %notin% d_srh$country] |>
  unique() |>
  as.character() |>
  stringi::stri_c(collapse = " and ")

# Surveys
srh_surveys <- d_srh$survey |> unique()
swl_surveys <- d_swl$survey |> unique()

n_surveys_srh <- srh_surveys |> length()
n_surveys_swl <- swl_surveys |> length()

s_in_srh_notin_swl <- srh_surveys[srh_surveys %notin% swl_surveys] |>
  as.character()
s_in_swl_notin_srh <- swl_surveys[swl_surveys %notin% srh_surveys] |>
  as.character()

surveys_by_class_srh <- d_srh |>
  dplyr::select(c, country, year, class) |>
  plyr::count() |>
  dplyr::select(class) |>
  plyr::count() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    perc = (freq / sum(freq) * 100) |>
      round(1)
  )

n_surveys_low_srh <- surveys_by_class_srh$freq[
  surveys_by_class_srh$class == "low"
]

surveys_by_class_swl <- d_swl |>
  dplyr::select(c, country, year, class) |>
  plyr::count() |>
  dplyr::select(class) |>
  plyr::count() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    perc = (freq / sum(freq) * 100) |>
      round(1)
  )

n_surveys_low_swl <- surveys_by_class_swl$freq[
  surveys_by_class_swl$class == "low"
]

if (identical(n_surveys_low_srh, n_surveys_low_swl)) {
  n_surveys_low <- n_surveys_low_srh
} else {
  n_surveys_low <- "ERROR"
}

n_c_low_srh <- d_srh |>
  dplyr::select(c, country, year, class) |>
  plyr::count() |>
  dplyr::filter(class == "low") |>
  dplyr::select(country) |>
  plyr::count() |>
  nrow()

n_c_low_swl <- d_swl |>
  dplyr::select(c, country, year, class) |>
  plyr::count() |>
  dplyr::filter(class == "low") |>
  dplyr::select(country) |>
  plyr::count() |>
  nrow()

if (identical(n_c_low_srh, n_c_low_swl)) {
  n_c_low <- n_c_low_srh
} else {
  n_c_low <- "ERROR"
}
```

In total, `r all_srh` and `r all_swl` individuals participated in the included surveys for self-rated health and life satisfaction, respectively (see flowchart in Figure S1). Due to individual missing values, `r all_missing_srh_low`-`r all_missing_srh_high` (self-rated health) and `r all_missing_swl_low`-`r all_missing_swl_high` (life satisfaction) individuals were excluded across the different models. The datasets for self-rated health and life satisfaction included data from `r n_surveys_srh` and `r n_surveys_swl` individual surveys, i.e., individual waves in different countries, conducted in `r n_countries_srh` and `r n_countries_swl` countries, respectively, with life satisfaction data additionally including the `r c_in_swl_notin_srh`. For both self-rated health and life satisfaction, `r n_surveys_low` surveys from `r n_c_low` countries were conducted in countries classified as having low income at the time.
